sources.title: Latest issuer results independently verified by lead
sources.supports: Lead independently opened the final Q2 2026 issuer release on 12 September 2026. Revenue USD20.230bn, attributable net income USD1.699bn, adjusted EBITDA USD4.027bn and operating cash flow USD2.335bn are corroborated. Prior financial-access failures in the audit are historical; the AI-programme and controlled-outcome limitations remain. The quarter-only after-tax screen is not comparable with an annual pre-tax illustration.

financial_anchor.metric: Q2 2026 revenue and attributable net income
financial_anchor.caveat: Reported/adjusted measures differ; cycle, mix and capital intensity confound.

ai_claim.claim: HCA and Google Cloud reported deployment work on generative nurse handoffs; omission, escalation and patient-outcome comparisons remain undisclosed.
ai_claim.stage: E1 announced deployment program; no opened controlled clinical result
ai_claim.scope: Specific workflow only; infrastructure demand is separated from own productivity.
ai_claim.limitation: No representative controlled cohort or retained-cash reconciliation.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: Q2 payer mix worsened and uninsured care created an estimated $400m income headwind while surgical volume softened.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Does not itself disprove the scoped mechanism.

rights_limit: Public terms do not prove universal training or pooled cross-customer reuse; enterprise schedules were unavailable.
materiality_summary: $84.95m = 5% of Q2 2026 attributable net income of $1.699bn. This is a quarter-only, after-tax screen and is NOT_COMPARABLE with the annual pre-tax benefit illustration; no annualization is assumed.

arithmetic.inputs: pool $28bn eligible salaries, benefits and purchased-services pool; efficiency 5%; realization 35%; retained share 40%; recurring cost $150m
arithmetic.formula: eligible cost × efficiency × realization × retained share − recurring AI expense
